Definition: to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize
BiblicalUsage: Nu means to refuse, to forbid, or to make of none effect. A father can disallow his daughter's vow in Numbers 30:5, and the Lord can bring the counsel of the heathen to nothing in Psalm 33:10, the same word for a human no and a divine one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's no overrules every human plan, and the counsel He frustrates was never going to stand.
